title: Animal tissues
examples: What is the main job of epithelial tissue?
Can you show me an example of connective tissue?
How are muscle tissues different from each other?

explain.say: Today we will look at the four main types of animal tissues.
Epithelial tissue covers surfaces and lines cavities in the body.
Connective tissue supports, binds together, or separates different body parts.
Muscle tissue is responsible for movement throughout the body.
Nervous tissue transmits electrical signals to communicate information.
In your everyday life, the skin is a great example of epithelial tissue.

faq.q: What is the difference between connective and epithelial tissue?
faq.a: Epithelial tissue covers surfaces, while connective tissue provides structural support to body parts.

faq.q: Does all muscle tissue work the same way?
faq.a: No, there are three types: skeletal for voluntary movement, smooth for organs, and cardiac for the heart.
asks: Are there different kinds of muscle?
What powers movement in the body?

faq.q: What is the main component of nervous tissue?
faq.a: Nervous tissue is mainly made up of neurons, which send electrical signals throughout the body.
asks: How does the body communicate signals?

faq.q: Can blood be considered connective tissue?
faq.a: Yes, blood is a classic example of connective tissue because it flows and connects different parts.
asks: Does blood fit with connective tissue?

faq.q: Which tissue type is found lining the inside of your stomach?
faq.a: The lining of the stomach is covered by epithelial tissue, which secretes digestive juices.
asks: Where is epithelial tissue found inside?

facts: Epithelial tissue forms protective barriers like the skin.
Connective tissue includes bone, which is a hard supporting material.
Skeletal muscle tissue allows us to move our bones when we choose to.
Cardiac muscle tissue is only found in the wall of the heart.

quiz.say: Tissue type that covers surfaces and lines cavities.
quiz.why: Epithelial tissue is specifically designed to cover and line surfaces.

wrong.0: Connective tissue is more about support, not just covering.
wrong.1: Muscle tissue's main job is to contract and cause movement.
wrong.2: Nervous tissue transmits signals, it does not form a surface layer.

quiz.say: Tissue responsible for the beating of the heart.
quiz.why: Cardiac muscle tissue is unique because it only works in the heart.

wrong.0: Smooth muscle is found in the walls of internal organs.
wrong.1: Epithelial tissue covers surfaces, it does not contract.
wrong.3: Skeletal muscle moves parts we can consciously control.

quiz.say: If a body part needs to transmit a rapid electrical signal, which tissue is most likely involved?
quiz.why: Nervous tissue is specialized for sending and receiving electrical impulses.

wrong.0: Muscle tissue uses chemical energy to create movement.
wrong.1: Epithelial tissue's job is to form barriers.
wrong.3: Connective tissue provides structure, but not rapid signals.
